Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following resources on computational linguistics for historical languages:

  • Johnson, Kyle P. et al. "The Classical Language Toolkit: An Open-Source Library for Text Analysis in Ancient and Medieval Languages." Proceedings of the ACL 2021 System Demonstrations, pp. 248–254.
  • TEI Consortium. "Chapter 17: Simple Analytic Mechanisms" and "Chapter 18: Feature Structures." TEI P5 Guidelines, Version 4.8.0, 2024.
  • Schmid, Helmut. "Probabilistic Part-of-Speech Tagging Using Decision Trees (TreeTagger)." International Conference on New Methods in Language Processing, Manchester, UK.
